item.description: Tokyo Cement Group (Tokyo Cement) reported a turnover of Rs. 15,836 million and a Profit After Tax (PAT) of Rs. 635 million for the 1st Quarter ended 30th June 2026, compared to a turnover of Rs. 12,544 million and a PAT of Rs. 668 million, in the same period last year.

item.title: [Daily FT - Front Page] Govt. reopens probe into missing $ 17.79 m legacy Treasury payments
item.description: The Government has reopened investigations into two overseas procurement transactions worth a combined $ 17.79 million, including payments for Australian milch cows and Chinese fertiliser, as part of a broader review of historic public expenditure, Public Security and Parliamentary Affairs Minister Ananda Wijepala told Parliament yesterday.
